summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $716K in annual savings – $685K finalized, $31K underway
summary.narrative: Treya Partners worked with Advantia Health to renegotiate key supplier contracts and optimize purchasing behaviors across seven spend areas. The engagement has already locked in $684,936 of recurring annual savings in six fully-implemented categories, with a further $31,459 in savings progressing through an IT Managed Services RFP. Early wins were realized within weeks of project launch through IUD sourcing changes, and additional benefits include streamlined supply distribution and the transition of sonography services to a lower-cost in-house model.
